policy.ask: Questions about this policy? Get in touch and we will answer.

about.title: Technology That Connects You to a Better Tomorrow
about.lead: Discover quality electronics, innovative gadgets and accessories at {store}.

who.title: Your online destination for electronics
who.first: {store} is an online store for electronics, gadgets and digital lifestyle products. We bring cameras, accessories, fashion and everyday tech together in one place, so you can find what you need without searching across many shops.
who.second: Every product in our store is selected with care and described clearly, so you can compare options and order with confidence from wherever you are.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To make technology accessible to everyone through carefully curated products, convenient online shopping and service that puts our customers first.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To build a trusted destination for electronics and digital lifestyle products, where customers return because shopping with us is simple, clear and dependable.

why.title: Why shop with {store}
why.body: Everything we do is designed to make buying electronics online easier.

curated.title: Curated Electronics
curated.body: A thoughtfully selected range of gadgets and accessories, chosen for usefulness and quality.

convenient.title: Convenient Shopping
convenient.body: Browse by department, search instantly, save favourites to your wishlist and order from home.

secure.title: Secure Checkout
secure.body: Pay through the options offered at checkout, processed by established payment providers.

support.title: Customer-Focused Support
support.body: Real people ready to help with product questions, orders and after-sales queries.

variety.title: Product Variety
variety.body: Cameras, accessories, fashion and more, with new products added to our collections over time.

assistance.title: Reliable Order Assistance
assistance.body: Follow your orders from your account and reach our team whenever you need an update.

commitment.title: Built around our customers
commitment.body: We are committed to making every visit worthwhile, from the first search to the moment your order arrives.

satisfaction.title: Customer satisfaction
satisfaction.body: We listen to feedback and work to resolve every question or issue fairly.

discovery.title: Easy product discovery
discovery.body: Clear product pages, organised departments and helpful search make the right choice easier.

transparency.title: Transparent service
transparency.body: Clear prices at checkout and published policies, so you always know where you stand.

cta.title: Ready to find your next gadget?
cta.body: Browse our collections or talk to our team. We are happy to help.

visit.title: Visit Our Store
visit.lead: Come see the collection in person.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.lead: Questions about an order or anything else? Write to us and we will reply.

content.email: Email {email} and we'll reply within a working day.

blog.title: From the journal
blog.emptyLead: New posts will show up here.
blog.olderFailed: We couldn't load older posts. Try again.

bulk.title: Bulk Buy
bulk.lead: Buying for your office, team, school or an event? Tell us what you need and we will put together a quote for your bulk order.

share.title: Share your requirement
share.body: Let us know the products, quantities and where they need to be delivered.

quote.title: Get your quote
quote.body: Our team checks availability and comes back to you with a quote for the full order.

deliver.title: Confirm and receive
deliver.body: Once you confirm, we pack your order with care and arrange delivery.

reach.title: Talk to our bulk orders team
reach.body: Call or write to us with your requirement and we will get back to you.

reviews.title: Customer Reviews
reviews.lead: Your feedback helps us choose better products and serve you better.

share.title: Bought from us recently?
share.body: We would love to hear how it went. Tell us about the product, the delivery and your experience with our team.
